title: AAPS only sporadically receives the BG values from XDrip. DEV-j
symptom: BG values arrive very irregularly in AAPS, sometimes with a 2 hour break. The problem only occurs in the DEV version, not in Master. Also, sync between master and follower via NS V3 is unreliable, while the old method works cleanly.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. Initial suggestions point to xDrip+ background/power management issues, but the reporter notes the problem is specific to the DEV version. Later, a maintainer found that setting 'Identify receiver' in xDrip+ fixed it for them, but the original reporter could not confirm. The thread ends with the reporter suspecting an xDrip problem after trying a different xDrip version.
fix: No definitive fix is stated. One participant (vanelsberg) resolved the issue for themselves by setting 'Settings -> Inter-app settings -> Identify receiver' in xDrip+, but the original reporter could not confirm this fix. The reporter later found that using a different xDrip version (from blaqone/xDrip) worked better but not perfectly.
settings_changed: Identify receiver → set (in xDrip+ Inter-app settings)
evidence_quote: Needed to set _Settings -> Inter-app settings -> Identify receiver_ to get it working (https://wiki.aaps.app/en/latest/Configuration/xdrip.html#xdrip-identify-receiver) So my bad: has been long since I tested xDrip+ for BG source. Never needed to set this so overlooked that option.
